content: Visual dialog BIBREF0 is an interesting new task combining the research efforts from Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval. While BIBREF1 presents some tips and tricks for VQA 2.0 Challenge, we follow their guidelines for the Visual Dialog challenge 2018. Our models use attention similar to BIBREF2 to get object level image representations from Faster R-CNN model BIBREF3. We experiment with different encoder mechanisms to get representations of conversational history.
